# net

Types from the Go package `net` (a library PocketBase builds on), as JavaScript sees them: they turn up as values of [PocketBase's types](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and of hook events.

## net.Addr

Addr represents a network end point address.

The two methods [`Addr.network`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/net#netaddr) and [`Addr.string`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/net#netaddr) conventionally return strings
that can be passed as the arguments to `Dial`, but the exact form
and meaning of the strings is up to the implementation.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `network()` | <code>(): string // name of the network (for example, &#34;tcp&#34;, &#34;udp&#34;)</code> |  |
| `string()` | <code>(): string // string form of address (for example, &#34;192.0.2.1:25&#34;, &#34;[2001:db8::1]:80&#34;)</code> |  |

## net.Conn

Conn is a generic stream-oriented network connection.

Multiple goroutines may invoke methods on a Conn simultaneously.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `read()` | <code>(b: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;): number</code> | Read reads data from the connection. Read can be made to time out and return an error after a fixed time limit; see SetDeadline and SetReadDeadline. |
| `write()` | <code>(b: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;): number</code> | Write writes data to the connection. Write can be made to time out and return an error after a fixed time limit; see SetDeadline and SetWriteDeadline. |
| `close()` | <code>(): void</code> | Close closes the connection. Any blocked Read or Write operations will be unblocked and return errors. Close may or may not block until any buffered data is sent; for TCP connections see [*TCPConn.SetLinger]. |
| `localAddr()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/net#netaddr">Addr</a></code> | LocalAddr returns the local network address, if known. |
| `remoteAddr()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/net#netaddr">Addr</a></code> | RemoteAddr returns the remote network address, if known. |
| `setDeadline()` | <code>(t: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timetime">time.Time</a>): void</code> | SetDeadline sets the read and write deadlines associated with the connection. It is equivalent to calling both SetReadDeadline and SetWriteDeadline. |
| `setReadDeadline()` | <code>(t: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timetime">time.Time</a>): void</code> | SetReadDeadline sets the deadline for future Read calls and any currently-blocked Read call. A zero value for t means Read will not time out. |
| `setWriteDeadline()` | <code>(t: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timetime">time.Time</a>): void</code> | SetWriteDeadline sets the deadline for future Write calls and any currently-blocked Write call. Even if write times out, it may return n > 0, indicating that some of the data was successfully written. A zero value for t means Write will not time out. |

## net.Listener

A Listener is a generic network listener for stream-oriented protocols.

Multiple goroutines may invoke methods on a Listener simultaneously.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `accept()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/net#netconn">Conn</a></code> | Accept waits for and returns the next connection to the listener. |
| `close()` | <code>(): void</code> | Close closes the listener. Any blocked Accept operations will be unblocked and return errors. |
| `addr()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/net#netaddr">Addr</a></code> | Addr returns the listener's network address. |
